The '''LCL-1 light laser cannon''' was a type of light [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] developed by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. LCL-1 laser cannons were twin-linked for high damage and increased power consumption, and they were favored by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who preferred to fight at close range, as the cannons' damage output dramatically dropped with distance.
